integrity: Universal identities proved by conditional-moment recurrences; executable independent finite-history enumeration confirms cases through nine vertices, without substituting finite checks for the proof. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-seed-vertex edge, one arrival edge and degree-proportional selection only. The bivariate distribution and variant attachment kernels are not characterized; archival implicit coverage remains a priority risk.
title: Positive covariance with nonmonotone root-degree regression in preferential attachment trees
